lines.text: The Israelites had sworn at Mizpah not to give daughters to Benjamites, then wept before God at Bethel.
No one from Jabesh-gilead had come to the assembly, so 12,000 valiant men found 400 young women there.
The men brought the young women to the camp at Hebron, and the Benjamites received them, but there were not enough.
The elders told the Benjamites to hide in the olive groves and catch wives from the dancing daughters of Shiloh.
The Benjamites rebuilt their cities and settled in them, and in those days there was no king in Israel.
